ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 1
   C. 7
   D. 7

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 36

4. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 13
   D. 41

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 9

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

10. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
